summary: Replicated request from the server to play a sound on a character's client; routed by ecl::ServerSoundSystem::RouteCharacterServerRequests (macOS). Born live in many dialogues, scripted events (explosions, collapses), idle and item use.

fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: Serializer bg3.exe+0x995AE0 member 1: 16 bytes at +0. macOS RouteCharacterServerRequests looks the two qwords at +0/+8 up in a HashMap<Guid, EntityHandle> (uuid -> handle) to find the character.

fields.name: SoundEvent
fields.evidence: Serializer member 2: ecs::sync::Serialize(FixedString*) at +0x10; RouteCharacterServerRequests passes it to character::SoundSystem::PlaySound / PlayerManager::PlaySoundForLocalPlayer.

fields.name: field_18
fields.evidence: Serializer member 4: 1 byte at +0x18; when set, RouteCharacterServerRequests resolves the sound through the current sound bank (type 9) and may play it as an external SFX instead.

fields.name: LocalPlayerOnly
fields.evidence: Serializer member 5: 1 byte at +0x19; macOS default strb wzr at +0x19; when set, RouteCharacterServerRequests calls PlayerManager::PlaySoundForLocalPlayer / PlayExternalSoundForLocalPlayer instead of the character sound system.

fields.name: _Pad1A
fields.evidence: tail padding to 32; live garbage (sometimes pointer-shaped)
